speaker.jigoku_pilot: Sleeves Personal Guard grunt pilot (under Angelo Sauper / Full Frontal)
speaker.basis: settled 2026-10-02 from fresh-translation review: Agrees with Jigoku's correction: generic Sleeves Personal Guard grunt (親衛隊/大尉/大佐 lines); not Kira.

proposed_by_v_mix_07.basis: Agrees with Jigoku's correction: generic Sleeves Personal Guard grunt (親衛隊/大尉/大佐 lines); not Kira.

speaker.jigoku_token: アンジェロ・ザウパー

alternatives: We have a mission to fulfill!

340:25.en: 「The Captain and we clear his path!」

alternatives: For the honor of the Guard!
Anyone who stands in my way...!

340:248.en: 「I'll bring you down no matter what!」
alternatives: I'll bring you down at any cost!
Slowpokes should stay out of this!

340:400.en: 「Don't think our title is for show!」
alternatives: Our name isn't just for show!
The Guard's name is well earned!
Careless of you to come so close!

340:655.en: 「It's too soon to take a breather!」

340:713.en: 「Even a Gundam can't beat the Guard!」
alternatives: Even Gundam is no match for us!

340:752.en: 「The Guard will take on the Gundam!」

alternatives: That Gundam knockoff can't face me!

340:888.en: 「$$ロンド・ベル$$!\nCan you handle us?!」
alternatives: Londo Bell!\nAre you a match for us?!

340:937.en: 「A $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ Gundam!」

alternatives: I'll crush you to make an example!

340:1145.en: 「That big body makes an easy target!」
alternatives: That huge frame is an easy target!
An AT dares challenge the Guard!

340:1277.en: 「Don't think a mere AS can win!」
alternatives: Don't think a mere AS can beat us!
Black Knights! Some of you survived!
All that machine has is agility!
An amateur has no place in battle!
Looks like you're a worthy opponent!

340:1491.en: 「A perfect foe to prove our power!」
alternatives: Perfect chance to prove our power!

340:1708.en: 「I'll hit before I lose the target!」
alternatives: I'll strike before I lose track!

340:1810.en: 「This is your fate for attacking us!」
alternatives: Attack us and this is what you get!
I'm following up with an attack!
I'll follow up with an attack!
I'll follow up with another attack!

340:1912.en: 「Captain $$アンジェロ$$, I'll back you up!」

340:2009.en: 「$$ガランシェール$$ crew,\nis that all?!」

340:2058.en: 「I won't let them hurt an ally!」
alternatives: I won't let them kill an ally!
Hurry! Move in to cover them!
The Guard must not lose anyone!

340:2162.en: 「I'll guard the Colonel with my life!」

alternatives: I have to cover the Commander...!
I'll show you I can do it!

340:2359.en: 「Take them out one at a time!」
alternatives: We'll take the enemies one by one!
Focus all fire on one target!
I can at least slow them down!
I'll at least slow them down!
At least I'll hold you here!
At least I can hold them back!
My means to counter are sealed...!
Damn! What a disgrace to the Guard!

340:2767.en: 「I knew you'd come at me that way.」

340:2794.en: 「I can manage at least this much!」
alternatives: A maneuver like that is easy!
This is the Guard's true power!
I won't tarnish the Guard's name!

340:2937.en: 「Did you see that, Colonel $$フロンタル$$!」

340:2980.en: 「You don't live up to Gundam's name!」
alternatives: You're unworthy of the Gundam name!
Gundam once won by name\nNo more!
Even the latest model looks pitiful!

340:3087.en: 「Is that all $$ロンド・ベル$$ can do?!」

alternatives: You're nothing but tame lapdogs now!
A hollow mock-up full of hot air!
All of you is so shallow...!
Not while I have this barrier!
You think that can hurt me?!
As if that could hurt me!
Damn it! I couldn't dodge it!

340:3598.en: 「You think that can beat the Guard?!」
alternatives: You think that'll defeat the Guard?!

340:3633.en: 「I damaged the machine I was granted!」
alternatives: I scarred the machine I was granted!

340:3674.en: 「I'll dodge next time, Capt. $$アンジェロ$$!」
alternatives: Next time I'll dodge, Angelo, sir!
I'm no match for the Colonel...!

340:3748.en: 「Damn! Next time won't go this way!」
alternatives: Damn! Next time won't go like this!
You just got lucky reading me...!

340:3906.en: 「You're a match for me... Not bad!」

alternatives: This isn't all the Guard can do...!
The Guard gets serious from here on!
Mock me, mock the Colonel!\nNo mercy!

340:4123.en: 「Gundam! You live up to the rumors!」
alternatives: Gundam! You're as good as they say!
The sound of bells is closing in...!

340:4310.en: 「Now you've done it, $$ソレスタルビーイング$$!」

alternatives: I-I can't lose to a traitor...!
Damn! That power is off the charts!
Too fast! I can't keep up...!
That AT pilot is no ordinary foe!

340:4697.en: 「An AS did this much damage to me?!」
alternatives: A mere AS did this much damage?!
Not to the fallen Black Knights...!
Waaah! Th-this is bad, really bad!

340:4925.en: 「A foe this strong... I had no idea!」
alternatives: Didn't expect a foe this strong...!
Are almost all the monitors dead?!
No...! But I'm in the Guard...!

340:5175.en: 「At this rate, I'll shame the Guard!」

alternatives: My pride!\nI won't go down easy!
I can't fail before the Colonel...!
Eject! It can't hold much longer!
Even if I fall... the Guard will...!

340:5609.en: 「Colonel $$フロンタル$$!\nNeo $$ジオン$$ will win!」
